$comment: L5 canon-as-data: the MindAttic.UiUx component catalog. codex front-matter equivalent: { codex:1, project:MindAttic.UiUx, code:MAU, layer:data, status:living, updated:2026-06-07 }. Schema: _schema/component.schema.json. Prose (BIBLE/README) cites these by id; do not restate fields. Folders verified on disk 2026-06-07 (13 components).

components.name: Cyberspace
components.summary: Cyberpunk console-background effects engine: 12 named effects, scan-line overlay, parallax circuit board, content keepout zones.

components.name: SacredGeometry
components.summary: Catalog of 1024 animatable line-art shapes; one pure renderer to live <canvas> or static SVG; build-previews.mjs emits one poster per shape.

components.name: OutfitFont
components.summary: Outfit variable font inlined as base64 woff2; two @font-face declarations plus the --font-outfit token.

components.name: AtticFont
components.summary: Attic display face inlined as base64 woff2; @font-face plus the --font-attic token; per-subscriber applyToSelector.

components.name: PinFooter
components.summary: Pin-when-short footer: toggles position:fixed bottom:0 on .pin-when-short while the document is shorter than the viewport.

components.name: BackHomeM
components.summary: A capital M in AtticFont pinned upper-left, linking back to mindattic.com; used on satellite sites.

components.name: WebSnapshot
components.summary: Capture a fresh screenshot of any URL with Playwright, cover-fit + crop it, and inline the result as a base64 data URI in any .web-snapshot container.

components.name: PageScrollbar
components.summary: Themed, draggable overlay scrollbar replacing the native browser scrollbar; Blazor razor wrapper for flash-free SSR; CSS-var themeable under .ma-scrollbar*.

components.name: Textbox
components.summary: Angular-Material-style outlined text field with floating label (Material notch effect); themeable via CSS vars; pairs with OutfitFont --font-outfit token.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Standalone, dependency-free, accessible tooltip driven by data-tooltip attribute; one reused floating node; namespaced under .ma-tooltip*; optional Blazor wrapper.

components.name: UserLogin
components.summary: Styling wrapper around the MindAttic.Authentication MaLogin static-SSR form; scoped CSS under .ul-card; Blazor Razor wrapper; does not implement authentication.

components.name: UserCircle
components.summary: Authenticated-only avatar/initials circle (upper-right); click opens a menu or signs out; reads ClaimsPrincipal via AuthorizeView; logout via native form+AntiforgeryToken.

components.name: UserTimeout
components.summary: 30-minute idle-timeout warning + auto-logout; countdown modal; renders and arms only when authenticated; logout via native form+AntiforgeryToken; static-SSR safe.
